relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a boy with Danon disease and a LAMP-2 variant: "The genetic test confirmed the presence of a mutation c.973dup;p (leu325profs25) in the LAMP-2 gene."
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; a Python script in scratch assembled the JSON and copied spans from the paper (non-breaking spaces kept as printed). No tables in the paper. The case patient is labelled 'patient' (rule 5). Five previously published people from the Discussion were included under the v4 rule because the paper gives features for them: three from Spinazzi et al. [4] ('three patients (two men and one woman) with severe HCM and AF who suffered from ischemic stroke'; sex cannot be assigned per person, features recorded as inferred from that named-group statement), one from Marino et al. [6] and one from Takeshi et al. [5] (the reference list names the first author of [5] as Tsuda; the text says 'Takeshi et al.', recorded as printed). Their Danon diagnosis is implied by context and the cited titles, not stated in the sentences, so disease_label_as_stated is 'not reported'. HCM was mapped to the checklist item 'left ventricular hypertrophy' for the ref [4] patients. Age at last evaluation recorded as 14-year-old (age at the stroke); the paper adds a 6-month follow-up without stating an age. Age at diagnosis not stated. The variant is printed 'c.973dup;p (leu325profs25)'; protein part recorded as printed; variant type, zygosity, inheritance and pathogenicity not stated. 'Preserved systolic function' at 10 years recorded as excluded 'reduced systolic function' but the composite checklist item (dilated or hypokinetic LV) left not reported. Possible internal tensions: the abstract says the thrombus was found 'in the absence of arrhythmic events' although the patient had WPW and atrioventricular block (both recorded; arrhythmia checklist items for SVT/VT left not reported); the coagulation test is called normal yet a factor VII deficiency was determined (both recorded). The thrombus was first described as 'suggestive of intracardiac thrombus' and later as 'demonstrating an intraventricular thrombus'; recorded observed with both spans. The Ethics section mentions 'all patients' and 'diaphragmatic ultrasonography', apparently boilerplate unrelated to this case; ignored.

span: An implantable cardioverter defibrillator was inserted due to atrioventricular block.
Mechanical thrombectomy was performed using stent retriever with complete flow restoration (TICI 3) in one pass
We initiated low-molecular weight heparin (enoxaparin 60 mg/12 hours) for 15 days as bridging therapy
Subsequently, we replaced apixaban 5 mg/12 hours instead of vitamin-K antagonist due to high bleeding risk.
